title: Underived scalar restriction and algebra-valued sheaf Hom adjunction
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and B a commutative algebra sheaf on Y [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf]. Write O for the ring sheaf obtained from Y.sheaf and B_R for the ring sheaf obtained from B.right. Scalar restriction from sheaves of B_R-modules to sheaves of O-modules along the ring-sheaf morphism induced by B.hom is left adjoint to the explicit functor sheafAlgebraHom Y B [def-pc-derived-rhom-algebra-module]. The latter has sections given by O-linear morphisms from B restricted to smaller opens into F, and B acts by precomposition with multiplication. No quasi-coherence hypothesis or derived category is needed.

source.place: Tag 0A6F; specialized to the construction of Duality for Schemes Tags 0BV0 and 0BV1

proof.text: For a B-module sheaf M and an O-module sheaf F, send phi: F_restr(M) -> F to psi_U(m)_V(b)=phi_V(b times res_UV(m)), for each V contained in U. Conversely evaluate psi_U(m) at 1 on U. Additivity and O-linearity follow from distributivity and phi being O-linear; B-linearity in m follows from associativity and commutativity and sheafAlgebraHom_smul. Restriction compatibility follows since ring restrictions preserve products and 1 and module restrictions preserve scalar multiplication. sheafAlgebraHom_underlying_linear gives O-linearity of the evaluation map. The composites are phi(1m)=phi(m) and psi(bm)(1)=(b psi(m))(1)=psi(m)(b). Precomposition in M and postcomposition in F commute with both formulas, and sheafAlgebraHomMap is postcomposition. Thus form natural Hom equivalences and apply CategoryTheory.Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv. The formulas require neither a nonzero unit nor a nonempty open, so zero B and empty Y are included.

theorem sheafAlgebraHom_adjunction (Y : Scheme.{u}) (B : Y.CommAlgebraSheaf) :
    Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u}
      ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map B.hom)) ⊣ sheafAlgebraHom Y B)
